stories.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
stories.body: The Iran-backed Houthis are also reported to have seized Perim - a strategic island on the major shipping route.

stories.title: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
stories.body: Princess Astrid "represented the Royal House in a warm and dutiful manner", the new king, Haakon VIII, said in a tribute to his aunt.

stories.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
stories.body: The powerful blast registered as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.

stories.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
stories.body: Auction house Sotheby's expects the dress to sell for up to $300,000 (£220,000) when it goes under the hammer on 9 December.

stories.title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
stories.body: Thai police also arrested a suspected female accomplice with whom the monk, who had taken a vow of celibacy, was filmed having sex.

stories.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
stories.body: The revelations in Anthropic's threat intelligence report come after a former top researcher at the company warned of the risks of AI to humanity.

stories.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists sentenced to up to seven years in prison
stories.body: Hong Kong used to be one of the only places in Chinese territory where people could gather to mark the 1989 crackdown.

stories.title: Philippine rescuers board ferry 40 hours after blaze began
stories.body: Thick, toxic fumes and extreme temperatures pose a challenge to rescuers who have boarded the ship.

stories.title: Six Nigerians accused of romance scams to be extradited to the US
stories.body: The six will face wire fraud and money-laundry charges in the US, South African police say.

stories.title: Five dead and dozens injured in coach crash in Swiss Alps
stories.body: The tourist coach was carrying dozens of Dutch passengers when it overturned in the south-eastern Swiss Alps.

stories.title: Man jailed after threatening to behead son's teacher in French village
stories.body: The father had threatened to kill a female primary school teacher for disciplining his son in class.

stories.title: Man loses case to claw back $369,000 he spent on lavish gifts for ex-girlfriend
stories.body: Singapore's High Court rules in the woman's favour, with the judge saying the man "willingly" showered her with gifts, even before they got together.

stories.title: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
stories.body: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.

stories.title: Lightning Houthi advance in Yemen may bring dangerous new dimension to Iran war
stories.body: The capture by the rebels of a stretch Yemen's strategic coastline is the group's most impressive military coup for several years.

stories.title: The student behind 'cockroach' protests that forced an Indian minister to quit
stories.body: It has been a rollercoaster ride for 'cockroach' party founder Abhijeet Dipke who gained celebrity status overnight.

stories.title: Spies, strategies and missed opportunities: How the lessons of 9/11 are still being learnt
stories.body: Twenty-five years on, the attacks have come to define a generation of foreign, security and intelligence policy, the BBC's security correspondent writes.

stories.title: Trump shadow looms large over Brics as Modi hosts Putin and Xi in Delhi
stories.body: As Brics leaders meet in Delhi, divisions within the bloc make a united response to Washington unlikely.

stories.title: Civilians told to flee Ukraine's fortress cities as Russia bids to control Donbas
stories.body: Kramatorsk and Slovyansk are now the main focus of Russian ground assaults, and residents are being told to leave.

stories.title: Can Trump really pay $5,000 to every American adult?
stories.body: Analysts question if the US president's election year offer is workable, legal or affordable.

stories.title: Four key takeaways from Republican midterms convention
stories.body: The US president covered many of the subjects he has returned to time and again - with a few surprises thrown in.
